findings.text: follow-on: the base arm did not run to completion (the log ends at 82% with no pytest summary or EXIT line), so the done-when's requirement that each id fail at the base revision in a recorded log is unmet by a completed run and the six failing ids cannot be read from it; negative-control.log reddens only three of them.

follow-on: the head arm's header names revision 6629fed0468f37540abab8039d5d75abc352e158 (the base commit) while its tree line reads "worktree, uncommitted node changes", so a reader taking the header revision at face value reads the 176-passed head arm as run at the base rather than at a9046c79c.

follow-on: the changed replay is reachable only through this module's own wrappers (replay_committed_rows, replay_project) and is imported by no production caller anywhere in the repository, so the fix has no runtime effect until another node wires it; the wiring is outside this node's declared scope.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 6629fed0468f37540abab8039d5d75abc352e158; a9046c79c adds a window length to _CLOCK_FIGURES (reckon/crew/pace_replay.py:445 _read_clock), rewrites _read_row (line 500) to read both clocks and flag a primary-only row, adds _operative_clock (line 549) and branches _recomputed_allowance (line 564) on the window the row reports, plus the two test files; all three files sit inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names six ids -- five in tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py (including its allowance-replay assertion) plus tests/test_pace_replay.py::test_a_damaged_field_marks_its_row_and_never_the_week -- passing at head and failing at base with zero added ids; head-gate.log records 176 passed EXIT=0 at head, but the base arm the manifest cites is truncated, so only the head half is a completed run.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make a recorded pace row replay its own allowance under window-length pacing; reckon/crew/pace_replay.py:564 _recomputed_allowance divides the operative window the row records (its length, elapsed fraction and reset) instead of a fixed week, and reckon/crew/pace_replay.py:549 _operative_clock selects that window by the length each clock carries.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete; after_suite carries 176 passed / 0 failures with log_path head-gate.log while baseline_suite is recorded honestly as completed false with failure_ids [] because its base-gate.log never reached a summary line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven write paths; the diff touches exactly three (reckon/crew/pace_replay.py, tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py, tests/test_pace_replay.py) and adds no file outside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_pace_replay.py:664 asserts the replay's reproduced allowance equals the producer-derived row["allowance"] from budget.pace_row (an independent source) and negative-control.log reddens it at EXIT=1 when the window length is dropped; the week-half fixture in tests/test_pace_replay.py:52 still builds its allowance through the same pace.allowance_for_group the module uses, so that half shares the module under test.
justifications.evidence: the head arm is recorded (head-gate.log, 176 passed EXIT=0) and I re-ran tests/test_pace_replay.py::test_a_primary_only_window_replays_its_own_allowance green at a9046c79c, but the base arm the done_when names is truncated (base-gate.log ends at 82% with no summary), so the "each fails at the base" half rests on an incomplete run.
justifications.fit: the new names (_operative_clock, _raw_at, _FIVE_HOUR_PERIOD) are mechanism-named with no plan or ticket identifier and follow the module's guarded-reader idiom at reckon/crew/pace_replay.py:445; _FIVE_HOUR_PERIOD duplicates the literal already in _CLOCK_PERIODS.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/pace_replay.py:564 reproduces the recorded allowance from the row's own window for both the short-sibling (week) and the primary-only (elapsed-fraction) branches, matching reckon/budget.py:1946 _group_allowance, which this node did not change.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff a9046c79c touches exactly three of the manifest's seven declared write paths and adds no file outside them.
